submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One native high-definition square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA game sprite, no sheet. Image 1 is edit target and exact geometry/arm ownership reference; image 2 definitive character identity for costume only; image 3 approved PRIMARY bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style.
Edit image 1 into EAST hit initial impact frame 01/06. Keep the same mostly upright body, head scale, grounded boot locations, correct arm ownership, and camera. Show incoming impact from screen RIGHT only just starting: both shoulders tighten slightly; knees begin a SMALL bend that lowers pelvis and head by 1% canvas height; torso is still almost upright and has NOT recoiled backward yet. Large blue eye opens wider in surprise, brow raises, mouth parts slightly. Near RIGHT elbow pulls the fan only slightly toward chest, retaining the same continuous near shoulder -> foreground sleeve -> fan-gripping RIGHT hand. Far LEFT empty arm lifts from hanging to a gentle bend at waist, fingers partly open. Keep near arm holding fan, far arm empty. Cloth and blue tassel show only first slight movement, not peak recoil sweep.
Preserve navy straight layered hair/small ponytail, turquoise-gold ornament/blue tassel, blue/ivory/gold scholar robe, cloud-wave patterns and ivory-blue dragon fan. Exactly two arms/hands/legs/boots. Same face identity, proportions, alpha-edge quality and full-body margins. True transparent background, no UI/text/labels, no shadow/floor, no particles/effects, no motion blur. No mirroring or pose-copy substitute.
